scope: Same linked-routine harness and JSNES core on current main ROM versus DrCBeatz experimental ROM. These are CPU cycle measurements of audio only, not whole-game FPS or controller latency. No SFX run covers three complete loops; simultaneous SFX run covers one full loop.

comparisons.mode: all four SFX owners, retrigger every frame (one full song loop)

songDataBytes.method: music_data_untitled start through end of first AUDIO_CODE module in linked map; song is last include of src/music.s

interpretation: Current songs have equal measured loop duration. Data length uses ROM storage; per-update workload depends on active channel envelopes and event decoding plus engine configuration. New arrangement costs about 95 extra CPU cycles per video frame on average (0.32% of total NTSC CPU budget), so shortening the song is not warranted for performance. Track/native-tempo versus old FamiTracker-tempo and duty configuration changed, so do not attribute every extra cycle to musical complexity alone.
